palindrome:
A palindrome is a sequence of characters which reads the same backward as forward. Here is a Python script to generate a palindrome string:

```python
def generate_palindrome(length):
    half = length // 2
    first_half = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"[:half]
    second_half = first_half[::-1]
    if length % 2 == 0:
        return first_half + second_half
    else:
        return first_half + 'z' + second_half

length = 256 # You can change the length as you want.
print(generate_palindrome(length))
```

This script generates a string of alphabets that reads the same backward and forward. It will generate a palindrome with the length 256 in this case.

Please note, Python strings are immutable which means once they are created, it can't be changed. Therefore, we have to make new string instead of changing existing one.

This script generates palindromes with alphabet characters only and does not include punctuation or spaces. It also doesn't handle non-English alphabets or special characters.

You might want to adjust the length to get a palindrome that fits your needs.
